blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — San Beda University Graduate School of Law Dean Fr. Ranhilio Aquino said the 16-vote threshold for convicting Vice President Sara Duterte in her impeachment trial should not be treated as fixed, arguing that only senators who actually participated in the proceedings should be counted.
